email.subject: Northwind Works Plumbing — quick site note
email.body:
Hi Sam,

I checked Northwind Works' site while looking at Harbor Falls plumbers. Two things are likely costing you calls: there are no reviews shown anywhere, so people comparing plumbers have nothing to judge you by and pick a competitor who has them. The footer also still shows an old copyright year, which reads as "this business may be inactive" to anyone double-checking before they call.

Both are quick, cheap fixes. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I mean, no obligation.

Worth 10 minutes this week?

Alex
Northlight Web
